systems.name: NS_VeyraImpact
systems.purpose: ADR-068 §4: a hit landing, drawn graphic: a four-point star snaps open and shrinks to a point over a white-hot flash, while a few hard streaks are flung out and up, each white-hot along its spine and cooling to the colour of the side that took it.

systems.name: NS_VeyraCastFlash
systems.purpose: ADR-068 §4: a cast committing, drawn graphic: a shockwave ring bursts out round the caster while hard streaks thrust toward where it was aimed, white-hot and cooling to the caster's side colour.

systems.name: NS_VeyraDeathBurst
systems.purpose: ADR-068 §4: a unit dying, drawn graphic: a white-hot flare and a wide shockwave in its side colour, and hard shards flung out and up.

systems.name: NS_VeyraLevelUp
systems.purpose: ADR-068 §4, ADR-065 §5: a Vanguard levelling up, drawn graphic: a shockwave ring and a four-point star burst round its body while hard streaks rise up through it, white-hot and cooling to its side colour, so the moment reads at a glance and from a distance.

systems.name: NS_VeyraTrail
systems.purpose: ADR-068 §4: a projectile's trail, drawn graphic: a stream of hard white-hot beads poured where it flies, each shrinking to nothing and cooling to its side colour, so the trail tapers behind it.

systems.name: NS_VeyraSmokeBody
systems.purpose: ADR-064 §1: a body of stylized smoke (Nix), poured off a body's bones as it moves; chunky puffs that glow as they leave the body, then rise, darken and erode away, in the colour the body gives.

systems.name: NS_VeyraSpray
systems.purpose: ADR-064 §1: the spray a living wave throws (Neris), flung off its crest and wake as it moves; small foam flecks that fly out, fall and erode, in the colour the body gives.

systems.name: NS_VeyraDrip
systems.purpose: ADR-064 §1: water sheeting off a body just come up out of a river (Cairn), running off its ledges and seams; small flecks of the lit stylized cloud material that drop, fall and break up, in the colour the body gives.

systems.name: NS_VeyraMist
systems.purpose: ADR-064 §1: mist that gathers round a body and moves with it (Sylra), welling up off its hem and legs; soft pale clumps of stylized cloud that drift a little, rise and thin away, in the colour the body gives.

systems.name: NS_VeyraEmbers
systems.purpose: ADR-064 §1: a molten body shedding embers (Varkesh), off its hands, forearms and core as it moves; small glowing flecks of stylized cloud that rise, cool and erode, in the colour the body gives.

systems.name: NS_VeyraWildstorm
systems.purpose: ADR-064 §1: a storm roared up around a body (Moro's Wildstorm); quick gusts of glowing stylized cloud thrown out from its flanks and legs, lifting and tearing away, in the colour the body gives.

systems.name: NS_VeyraWave
systems.purpose: ADR-064 §1: the living wave a rider stands on (Neris), water in motion rather than a mesh: a churning swell of dark water under and behind her, a crest heaving up behind her and throwing forward at her heels, white foam about her and spray off its lip, trailing her as she moves, all of it at or below her feet so it never hides her; sized by how far her body grows the wave (User.Scale), the water a deep shade of the colour the body gives, the foam that colour.

systems.name: NS_VeyraTempest
systems.purpose: ADR-064 §1: the storm Neris calls down while she changes the weather (her Storm body): her wave storm-tossed under her, its water darker; dark squall cloud roiling up around her, rain driving down and slanting with the wind, and lightning flashing in the cloud above; the foam, spray, rain and lightning in the colour the body gives, the water and cloud storm-dark shades of it.

systems.name: NS_VeyraChargeSwirl
systems.purpose: ADR-072 §6: a skill winding up, drawn graphic and looping on the caster's bones until its stage ends it: hard white-hot motes gather into a bright knot, flaring and rising off it, cooling to the caster's side colour.

systems.name: NS_VeyraShockwave
systems.purpose: ADR-072 §6: a slam or an eruption meeting the ground, drawn graphic: a wide shockwave ring bursts out over a white-hot flare while hard chunks are flung up and fall, cooling to the side colour.

systems.name: NS_VeyraSlashArc
systems.purpose: ADR-072 §6: a thrust or a sweep released, drawn graphic: a fan of hard streaks driven out ahead over a four-point star, white-hot and cooling to the side colour.

systems.name: NS_VeyraBeam
systems.purpose: ADR-072 §6: a channelled beam, drawn graphic and looping until its channel ends: a solid band of white-hot flares packed along its length (User.Length) ahead of its caster, each flaring and cooling to the side colour, so the band shimmers but never breaks.

systems.name: NS_VeyraShardRain
systems.purpose: ADR-072 §6: fragments falling onto an area and shattering, drawn graphic: hard shards burst up and out of a ring as the area lands, white-hot and cooling to the side colour.

systems.name: NS_VeyraMoltenSplash
systems.purpose: ADR-072 §6: molten metal striking the ground, drawn graphic: glowing blobs of molten stuff thrown up and falling back over a scorched ring, cooling to the side colour.

systems.name: NS_VeyraShellSet
systems.purpose: ADR-072 §6: a shell or a guard setting hard about a body, drawn graphic: a ring snaps tight round it over a white-hot flare as hard plates are flung up its sides, cooling to the side colour.

systems.name: NS_VeyraChainTrail
systems.purpose: ADR-072 §6: a hook flying on its chain, drawn graphic and looping while it flies: a heavy stream of hard links poured where it flies, each slow to fade, cooling to the side colour, so the chain reads back toward its thrower.
